'''Kendara Farlion''', called '''Dara''' for short and nicknamed '''Spike''', was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] road manager of [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
